August 31 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 451)

This archival dispatch kicks off the comprehensive multi-day archival calendar walk for August 31, documenting historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting across British BBC radio drama and American network radio, Robert Gould and Ray Dunbobbin in The Musgrave Ritual on BBC Radio 4 (1981), Fran Striker's maritime adventure The Sea Hound (Episode 61, 1942), Kay Kyser and Ish Kabibble on Kollege of Musical Knowledge for Lucky Strike (1939), Harry Elders in two romantic radio plays on Curtain Time for Mars Candy (1946, 1949), and a wartime Salute to America pre-emption (1939–1981):
